description: Town-level living score plus 3-year youth population and business decline forecasts for Jeonbuk

models.youth_net_migration: Cohort residual estimate of 20-39 net migration, validated against KOSIS city migration
models.youth_forecast: LightGBM panel regression of 3-year log youth change, chosen over Hamilton-Perry and trend baselines by population-weighted rolling-origin backtest; size-stratified conformal 80% intervals; SHAP drivers
models.business_decline: LightGBM classifiers (1 and 3 years) for a 10%+ drop in establishments by town and KSIC section, Platt-calibrated on out-of-time backtest scores

notes: Forecast inputs exclude bus data (no history) and use city-level medical counts only. SHAP shows predictive contribution, not causal effect.
